# GimbalAbsAngleControl (command)

Gimbal AbsAngleControl - a distinct command from AngleControl (0x0a), not a variant: no duration field, and the flags byte is explicit here (not opaque). Source: DataGimbalAbsAngleControl.java, confirmed byte-for-byte 2026-10-24 against real dji.pilot decompile.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** dji.pilot decompile, DataGimbalAbsAngleControl.java. Defaults (yaw/roll invalid, pitch only) match a real-hardware test (2026-10-24); the app's own un-set default is all-axes-valid (every bit 0) - not confirmed our pitch-only default is required, only that it is what was tested. Was scripts/re/duml_commands.py's `GimbalAbsAngleControl`/`gimbal.absAngle`.
